acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /api/scores endpoint returning all scores from Neon Postgres
syncFromWebDb() helper in mobile db/sync.ts syncing scores, recent plays, and songs without touching SEGA
Graceful fallback in fullSync() when SEGA servers are down/unreachable
Sync with Web App DB buttons in Settings and Arcade tabs
Clean TypeScript compilation across mobile and web

checkpointPayload.description: Direct sync between Neon Postgres (web app DB) and SQLite (mobile DB) without scraping SEGA. Allows mobile app to populate and update during maimai NET maintenance or outages.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan:
1. Create GET /api/scores endpoint in apps/web/app/api/scores/route.ts returning all user scores from Neon Postgres
2. Implement syncFromWebDb() in apps/mobile/db/sync.ts to fetch scores, recent plays, and songs without touching SEGA
3. Add fallback in fullSync() when SEGA is down, reporting server offline status gracefully
4. Add dedicated "Sync with Web App DB" buttons in Settings and Arcade tabs
5. Verify compilation with tsc --noEmit and test sync data population
checkpointPayload.title: Web DB to Mobile DB Sync
